governing_policy_rule: Deterministic physics model remains authoritative. Effective safe window = min(physics, surrogate). Physics clamping unconditionally eliminates remaining surrogate false-safe risks.

operating_regimes.normal_regime: ML surrogate endpoint provides rapid sub-second non-linear thermal predictions under typical ambient and cooling conditions.
operating_regimes.edge_case_regime: Extreme temperatures, sensor anomalies, or missing telemetry safely activate deterministic physics simulation.
